messages:
Alex: quick poll — lunch for today: 1) Sushi 🍣 2) Tacos 🌮 3) Salad 🥗. Bonus micro-poll: which editor actually wins your heart? A) VS Code B) Vim C) JetBrains D) Nano. React with numbers/letters or drop a comment. poll closes in 30m :smile:
SnackBot: Poll created (tues-grub). Vote by reacting: :one:, :two:, :three:. Micro-poll: :regional_indicator_a:, :regional_indicator_b:, :regional_indicator_c:, :regional_indicator_d:
Priya: :two: Tacos + :regional_indicator_b: Vim :heart:
Sam: :two: Tacos for the win. also :regional_indicator_a: (VS Code) — extensions are life
Maria: :one: Sushi for me. JetBrains for heavy refactors :nerd_face:
Dave: :three: Salad. and :regional_indicator_d: Nano for tiny quick edits :laughing:
Lina: :two: tacos + :regional_indicator_a: (VS Code, but i use vim mode sometimes)
Alex: ok counting manually so far: tacos 3, sushi 1, salad 1. editors A:2, B:1, C:1, D:1 — thanks for the quick replies
Alex: adding my vote: :two: tacos + :regional_indicator_a: VS Code (can't quit the debugger ux)
Alex: closing poll in 5m — final tally incoming :chart_with_upwards_trend:
SnackBot: Poll closed. Results — Lunch: Tacos (4), Sushi (1), Salad (1). Editors: VS Code (3), Vim (1), JetBrains (1), Nano (1). Summary: tacos win. :taco:
Sam: tacos victory dance :tada: Anyone want extra spicy? I'll get one mild and one spicy in case.
Priya: spicy for me pls :fire: thanks Alex!
Alex: ordering now. ETA 20-30m. kitchen meetup at 12:45? :fork_and_knife:
Maria: i'll bring extra soy sauce packets :grin:
Dave: i'll swing by for the salad option. see y'all in a bit :)
